author: Multiplayer Everything
name: Bow Man

steps: Press Play online. A message shows your room code; send it to your friend. The game starts once they have joined.
Your friend types the code in Join by code, or picks your room in the Rooms list.
The host clicks VS Human in the menu. The host is the left archer and the friend is the right archer.

keys.does: Draw the bow (Enter or F also work).
Aim and shoot with your own mouse.

tips: Two archers take turns, each on their own PC; only the host mouse works in the menus.
Everyone needs the same Ruffle Together build and game file; the launcher keeps them current.

description: Two archers take turns: drag to aim, release to shoot, mind the wind. Online play runs in Ruffle Together: each archer is on their own PC.

offline.description: VS Computer, practice and bird hunting
